1	-- T1 schema: tables, constraints, triggers, RLS helpers, RLS policies, grants, storage bucket + policies.
2	-- Source of truth for the DB (R47); prisma/schema.prisma is pulled from it.
3	
4	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
5	-- 0. Extensions, schema, privilege lockdown (before any object exists)
6	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
7	create extension if not exists btree_gist with schema extensions; -- D16: uuid "=" inside a gist EXCLUDE
8	
9	create schema if not exists private;
10	
11	-- R42: nothing we create in public is reachable by anon/authenticated unless granted below.
12	alter default privileges in schema public revoke all on tables from anon, authenticated;
13	alter default privileges in schema public revoke all on sequences from anon, authenticated;
14	alter default privileges in schema public revoke all on functions from anon, authenticated;
15	alter default privileges in schema public revoke execute on functions from public;
16	alter default privileges in schema private revoke all on tables from anon, authenticated;
17	alter default privileges in schema private revoke all on sequences from anon, authenticated;
18	alter default privileges in schema private revoke all on functions from anon, authenticated;
19	alter default privileges in schema private revoke execute on functions from public;
20	-- R42: the per-schema form above cannot remove the global PUBLIC execute default (Postgres grants it
21	-- unless the role-wide default is revoked), so revoke it for the migration owner as well.
22	alter default privileges for role postgres revoke execute on functions from public;
23	
24	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	-- 1. Tables
26	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
27	create table public.organizations (
28	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
29	  name text not null check (char_length(btrim(name)) > 0),
30	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
31	);
32	
33	create table public.memberships (
34	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
35	  -- D17: unique(user_id) = a staff member or manager belongs to exactly one organization (R2).
36	  user_id uuid not null unique references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
37	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
38	  role text not null check (role in ('manager', 'staff')),
39	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
40	);
41	create index memberships_org_id_idx on public.memberships (org_id);
42	
43	create table public.units (
44	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
45	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
46	  name text not null check (char_length(btrim(name)) > 0),
47	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
48	  unique (org_id, name),
49	  unique (org_id, id) -- composite FK target: a lease can only point at a unit of its own org (R39)
50	);
51	
52	create table public.tenants (
53	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
54	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
55	  -- D17: tenant role comes from tenants.user_id, never user_metadata (R37).
56	  user_id uuid null references auth.users (id) on delete set null,
57	  full_name text not null check (char_length(btrim(full_name)) > 0),
58	  email text not null,
59	  phone text null check (phone ~ '^\+?[0-9][0-9 -]{5,19}$'),
60	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
61	  unique (org_id, user_id),
62	  unique (org_id, id)
63	);
64	create index tenants_user_id_idx on public.tenants (user_id); -- RLS: user_id = auth.uid()
65	
66	create table public.leases (
67	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
68	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
69	  unit_id uuid not null,
70	  tenant_id uuid not null,
71	  start_date date not null,
72	  end_date date not null,
73	  monthly_rent_sen bigint not null check (monthly_rent_sen > 0), -- D3: bigint sen
74	  deposit_sen bigint not null check (deposit_sen >= 0),
75	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'), -- D3: single currency
76	  created_by uuid null,
77	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
78	  check (end_date >= start_date),
79	  foreign key (org_id, unit_id) references public.units (org_id, id),
80	  foreign key (org_id, tenant_id) references public.tenants (org_id, id),
81	  unique (org_id, id),
82	  unique (id, org_id),
83	  -- D16: same-unit leases never overlap, both dates inclusive, race-proof (23P01 -> 409) (R46).
84	  constraint leases_no_overlap exclude using gist (
85	    unit_id with =,
86	    daterange(start_date, end_date, '[]') with &&
87	  )
88	);
89	create index leases_org_unit_idx on public.leases (org_id, unit_id);
90	create index leases_org_tenant_idx on public.leases (org_id, tenant_id);
91	create index leases_tenant_id_idx on public.leases (tenant_id);
92	
93	create table public.invoices (
94	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
95	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
96	  lease_id uuid not null,
97	  kind text not null check (kind in ('deposit', 'rent')),
98	  period_index int null,
99	  period_start date null,
100	  period_end date null,
101	  due_date date not null,
102	  -- R46: lease creation stores exactly generateSchedule's invoices, and a tiny last rent period can
103	  -- round to 0 sen; a deposit invoice exists only when the deposit is > 0.
104	  amount_sen bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0 or (kind = 'rent' and amount_sen = 0)),
105	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'),
106	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
107	  -- R12/R14: deposit has no period; a rent invoice has one, due on its anchor (period start).
108	  check (
109	    (kind = 'deposit' and period_index is null and period_start is null and period_end is null)
110	    or (kind = 'rent' and period_index is not null and period_start is not null and period_end is not null
111	        and period_index >= 0 and period_end >= period_start and due_date = period_start)
112	  ),
113	  foreign key (org_id, lease_id) references public.leases (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
114	  -- R12/R16: deposit rows have period_index null, so NULLS NOT DISTINCT = at most one deposit per lease
115	  -- and one rent invoice per period index (a partial unique on lease_id would make Prisma model lease 1:1).
116	  constraint invoices_lease_period_index_key unique nulls not distinct (lease_id, period_index),
117	  unique (org_id, lease_id, period_start), -- kit rule: invoice generation idempotent per period
118	  unique (org_id, id),
119	  unique (lease_id, id) -- target for payment_allocations: invoice and payment on the same lease
120	);
121	create index invoices_org_lease_idx on public.invoices (org_id, lease_id);
122	
123	create table public.gateway_bills (
124	  -- R30: gen_random_uuid() = 122 random bits, so bill ids cannot be guessed.
125	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
126	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
127	  lease_id uuid not null,
128	  amount_sen bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0),
129	  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending', 'paid', 'failed')),
130	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'),
131	  created_by uuid null,
132	  transaction_id text null,
133	  transaction_status text null,
134	  paid_at timestamptz null,
135	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
136	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
137	  check (status <> 'paid' or paid_at is not null),
138	  foreign key (org_id, lease_id) references public.leases (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
139	  unique (org_id, id),
140	  unique (lease_id, id)
141	);
142	create index gateway_bills_org_lease_idx on public.gateway_bills (org_id, lease_id);
143	create index gateway_bills_lease_id_idx on public.gateway_bills (lease_id);
144	
145	create table public.payments (
146	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
147	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
148	  lease_id uuid not null,
149	  amount_sen bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0),
150	  unapplied_sen bigint not null default 0,
151	  method text not null check (method in ('cash', 'bank_transfer', 'online')),
152	  status text not null check (status in ('pending_verification', 'approved', 'rejected', 'voided')),
153	  received_at timestamptz not null,
154	  slip_path text null unique, -- D22: one slip file backs at most one payment
155	  gateway_bill_id uuid null unique, -- D10: "A bill creates at most one payment, ever." (R35)
156	  idempotency_key uuid null, -- D9: optional Idempotency-Key header
157	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'),
158	  recorded_by uuid null,
159	  decided_by uuid null,
160	  decided_at timestamptz null,
161	  reason text null,
162	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
163	  check (unapplied_sen >= 0 and unapplied_sen <= amount_sen),
164	  -- R26: only online money can be left unapplied (manual payments are capped, R22/R23).
165	  check (method = 'online' or unapplied_sen = 0),
166	  check ((method = 'bank_transfer') = (slip_path is not null)), -- R20
167	  check ((method = 'online') = (gateway_bill_id is not null)),
168	  -- D22/R44: a slip lives in its own organization's folder <org_id>/...
169	  check (slip_path is null or split_part(slip_path, '/', 1) = org_id::text),
170	  -- R24: reject and void need a reason of at least 5 characters; coalesce because a NULL reason
171	  -- would make the CHECK evaluate to NULL, which passes.
172	  check (status not in ('rejected', 'voided') or coalesce(char_length(btrim(reason)), 0) >= 5),
173	  foreign key (org_id, lease_id) references public.leases (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
174	  foreign key (org_id, gateway_bill_id) references public.gateway_bills (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
175	  foreign key (lease_id, gateway_bill_id) references public.gateway_bills (lease_id, id) on delete restrict,
176	  -- gateway_bill_id is already unique; these two composite uniques are the exact FK column sets so the
177	  -- relations introspect as 1:1 in Prisma, and they double as the FK indexes.
178	  unique (org_id, gateway_bill_id),
179	  unique (lease_id, gateway_bill_id),
180	  unique (org_id, idempotency_key),
181	  unique (org_id, id),
182	  unique (lease_id, id)
183	);
184	create index payments_org_lease_idx on public.payments (org_id, lease_id);
185	create index payments_lease_status_idx on public.payments (lease_id, status);
186	
187	create table public.payment_allocations (

190	  lease_id uuid not null,
191	  payment_id uuid not null,

201	create index payment_allocations_lease_payment_idx on public.payment_allocations (lease_id, payment_id);
202	create index payment_allocations_lease_invoice_idx on public.payment_allocations (lease_id, invoice_id);
203	create index payment_allocations_org_lease_idx on public.payment_allocations (org_id, lease_id);
204	create index payment_allocations_invoice_id_idx on public.payment_allocations (invoice_id);
205	
206	create table public.audit_log (
207	  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
208	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
209	  actor_id uuid null,
210	  action text not null,
211	  entity_id uuid null,
212	  details jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
213	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
214	);
215	create index audit_log_org_created_idx on public.audit_log (org_id, created_at);
216	
217	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
218	-- 2. Guard triggers (schema private)
219	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
220	-- D19/R43: audit_log is append-only for every role, owner and service_role included.
221	create function private.audit_log_append_only() returns trigger
222	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
223	begin
224	  raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'audit_log is append-only';
225	end $$;
226	
227	create trigger audit_log_no_update_delete before update or delete on public.audit_log
228	  for each row execute function private.audit_log_append_only();
229	create trigger audit_log_no_truncate before truncate on public.audit_log
230	  for each statement execute function private.audit_log_append_only();
231	-- D19: ALWAYS = still fires under session_replication_role = replica.
232	alter table public.audit_log enable always trigger audit_log_no_update_delete;
233	alter table public.audit_log enable always trigger audit_log_no_truncate;
234	
235	-- D12: payments are never deleted; only the decision columns change, along fixed status transitions.
236	create function private.payments_guard() returns trigger
237	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
238	begin
239	  if tg_op <> 'UPDATE' then
240	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Payments are never deleted';
241	  end if;
242	  -- D12: compare the whole row minus the mutable keys, so any future column is immutable by default.
243	  if (to_jsonb(new) - array['status', 'decided_by', 'decided_at', 'reason', 'unapplied_sen'])
244	     is distinct from (to_jsonb(old) - array['status', 'decided_by', 'decided_at', 'reason', 'unapplied_sen']) then
245	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Payment facts are immutable';
246	  end if;
247	  if new.status is distinct from old.status and not (
248	       (old.status = 'pending_verification' and new.status in ('approved', 'rejected'))
249	       or (old.status = 'approved' and new.status = 'voided')) then
250	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Payment status cannot change that way';
251	  end if;
252	  return new;
253	end $$;
254	
255	create trigger payments_guard_row before update or delete on public.payments
256	  for each row execute function private.payments_guard();
257	create trigger payments_guard_truncate before truncate on public.payments
258	  for each statement execute function private.payments_guard();
259	alter table public.payments enable always trigger payments_guard_row;
260	alter table public.payments enable always trigger payments_guard_truncate;
261	
262	-- Allocations are deleted by void (R24) but never edited in place.
263	create function private.payment_allocations_no_update() returns trigger
264	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
265	begin
266	  raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Allocations cannot be updated';
267	end $$;
268	
269	create trigger payment_allocations_no_update before update on public.payment_allocations
270	  for each row execute function private.payment_allocations_no_update();
271	
272	-- Generic guard: the columns named in the trigger arguments never change after insert.
273	create function private.forbid_column_changes() returns trigger
274	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
275	declare
276	  v_col text;
277	begin
278	  foreach v_col in array tg_argv loop
279	    if (to_jsonb(new) -> v_col) is distinct from (to_jsonb(old) -> v_col) then
280	      raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = format('%s.%s is immutable', tg_table_name, v_col);
281	    end if;
282	  end loop;
283	  return new;
284	end $$;
285	
286	-- Lease terms and invoice amounts/dates are facts fixed at creation (R46: exactly generateSchedule's invoices).
287	create trigger leases_immutable before update on public.leases
288	  for each row execute function private.forbid_column_changes(
289	    'id', 'org_id', 'unit_id', 'tenant_id', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'monthly_rent_sen', 'deposit_sen', 'currency');
290	create trigger invoices_immutable before update on public.invoices
291	  for each row execute function private.forbid_column_changes(
292	    'id', 'org_id', 'lease_id', 'kind', 'period_index', 'period_start', 'period_end', 'due_date', 'amount_sen', 'currency');
293	
294	-- R34: a bill's amount and lease never change and its status only moves forward ("a paid bill never goes back").
295	create function private.gateway_bills_guard() returns trigger
296	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
297	begin
298	  if tg_op <> 'UPDATE' then
299	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Gateway bills are never deleted';
300	  end if;
301	  if (new.id, new.org_id, new.lease_id, new.amount_sen, new.currency, new.created_by, new.created_at)
302	     is distinct from (old.id, old.org_id, old.lease_id, old.amount_sen, old.currency, old.created_by, old.created_at) then
303	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Gateway bill facts are immutable';
304	  end if;
305	  if new.status is distinct from old.status and not (
306	       (old.status = 'pending' and new.status in ('paid', 'failed'))
307	       or (old.status = 'failed' and new.status = 'paid')) then
308	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Gateway bill status cannot go back';
309	  end if;
310	  -- R34: a paid bill never goes back, so its payment facts are frozen too.
311	  if old.status = 'paid'
312	     and (new.paid_at, new.transaction_id, new.transaction_status)
313	         is distinct from (old.paid_at, old.transaction_id, old.transaction_status) then
314	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'A paid gateway bill cannot change';
315	  end if;
316	  return new;
317	end $$;
318	
319	create trigger gateway_bills_guard_row before update or delete on public.gateway_bills
320	  for each row execute function private.gateway_bills_guard();
321	create trigger gateway_bills_guard_truncate before truncate on public.gateway_bills
322	  for each statement execute function private.gateway_bills_guard();
323	-- D19: ALWAYS = still fires under session_replication_role = replica.
324	alter table public.gateway_bills enable always trigger gateway_bills_guard_row;
325	alter table public.gateway_bills enable always trigger gateway_bills_guard_truncate;
326	
327	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
328	-- 3. RLS helpers (SECURITY DEFINER so policies never recurse through RLS; search_path '' against hijacking)
329	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
330	create function private.is_org_member(p_org uuid, p_roles text[]) returns boolean
331	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
332	  select exists (
333	    select 1 from public.memberships m
334	    where m.org_id = p_org and m.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and m.role = any (p_roles)
335	  )
336	$$;
337	
338	create function private.is_lease_tenant(p_lease uuid) returns boolean
339	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
340	  select exists (
341	    select 1
342	    from public.leases l
343	    join public.tenants t on t.org_id = l.org_id and t.id = l.tenant_id
344	    where l.id = p_lease and t.user_id = (select auth.uid())
345	  )
346	$$;
347	
348	create function private.is_tenant_org(p_org uuid) returns boolean
349	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
350	  select exists (
351	    select 1 from public.tenants t where t.org_id = p_org and t.user_id = (select auth.uid())
352	  )
353	$$;
354	
355	-- D22/R44: first folder of the object path must be an org where the caller is manager or staff.
356	-- Compared as text so a garbage folder name returns false instead of raising a uuid cast error.
357	create function private.can_upload_slip(p_object_name text) returns boolean
358	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
359	  select exists (
360	    select 1 from public.memberships m
361	    where m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
362	      and m.role in ('manager', 'staff')
363	      and m.org_id::text = (storage.foldername(p_object_name))[1]
364	  )
365	$$;
366	
367	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
368	-- 4. Row level security (R42 Data API matrix). SELECT only, plus tenant phone update.
369	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
370	alter table public.organizations enable row level security;
371	alter table public.memberships enable row level security;
372	alter table public.units enable row level security;
373	alter table public.tenants enable row level security;
374	alter table public.leases enable row level security;
375	alter table public.invoices enable row level security;
376	alter table public.gateway_bills enable row level security;
377	alter table public.payments enable row level security;
378	alter table public.payment_allocations enable row level security;
379	alter table public.audit_log enable row level security;
380	
381	create policy organizations_select on public.organizations for select to authenticated
382	  using (private.is_org_member(id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_tenant_org(id));
383	
384	create policy memberships_select on public.memberships for select to authenticated
385	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']));
386	
387	create policy units_select on public.units for select to authenticated
388	  using (
389	    private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff'])
390	    or exists (
391	      select 1 from public.leases l
392	      where l.org_id = units.org_id and l.unit_id = units.id and private.is_lease_tenant(l.id)
393	    )
394	  );
395	
396	create policy tenants_select on public.tenants for select to authenticated
397	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or user_id = (select auth.uid()));
398	
399	-- R42: tenant updates only their own phone (column grant below limits the columns; WITH CHECK keeps the row theirs).
400	create policy tenants_update_own_phone on public.tenants for update to authenticated
401	  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()))
402	  with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
403	
404	create policy leases_select on public.leases for select to authenticated
405	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(id));
406	
407	create policy invoices_select on public.invoices for select to authenticated
408	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
409	
410	create policy gateway_bills_select on public.gateway_bills for select to authenticated
411	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
412	
413	create policy payments_select on public.payments for select to authenticated
414	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
415	
416	create policy payment_allocations_select on public.payment_allocations for select to authenticated
417	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
418	
419	create policy audit_log_select on public.audit_log for select to authenticated
420	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager']));
421	
422	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
423	-- 5. Grants (after every object exists)
424	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
425	revoke all on all tables in schema public from anon, authenticated;
426	revoke all on all sequences in schema public from anon, authenticated;
427	revoke all on all functions in schema public from anon, authenticated;
428	revoke all on all functions in schema private from public, anon, authenticated;
429	
430	grant select on public.organizations, public.memberships, public.units, public.tenants, public.leases,
431	  public.invoices, public.gateway_bills, public.payments, public.payment_allocations, public.audit_log
432	  to authenticated;
433	grant update (phone) on public.tenants to authenticated;
434	
435	-- Policies (and Storage's RLS) call these helpers as the authenticated role; nothing else in private is callable.
436	grant usage on schema private to authenticated;
437	grant execute on function private.is_org_member(uuid, text[]) to authenticated;
438	grant execute on function private.is_lease_tenant(uuid) to authenticated;
439	grant execute on function private.is_tenant_org(uuid) to authenticated;
440	grant execute on function private.can_upload_slip(text) to authenticated;
441	
442	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
443	-- 6. Storage: private slip bucket + object policies (R20, R44, D22)
444	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
445	insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
446	values ('payment-slips', 'payment-slips', false, 5242880, '{image/jpeg,image/png,application/pdf}')
447	on conflict (id) do nothing;
448	
449	-- Staff/manager of the org in the first folder may upload and read; no update/delete/list for anyone else.
450	create policy payment_slips_insert on storage.objects for insert to authenticated
451	  with check (bucket_id = 'payment-slips' and private.can_upload_slip(name));
452	
453	create policy payment_slips_select on storage.objects for select to authenticated
454	  using (bucket_id = 'payment-slips' and private.can_upload_slip(name));
455

content.content:
1	-- T1 schema: tables, constraints, triggers, RLS helpers, RLS policies, grants, storage bucket + policies.
2	-- Source of truth for the DB (R47); prisma/schema.prisma is pulled from it.
3	
4	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
5	-- 0. Extensions, schema, privilege lockdown (before any object exists)
6	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
7	create extension if not exists btree_gist with schema extensions; -- D16: uuid "=" inside a gist EXCLUDE
8	
9	create schema if not exists private;
10	
11	-- R42: nothing we create in public is reachable by anon/authenticated unless granted below.
12	alter default privileges in schema public revoke all on tables from anon, authenticated;
13	alter default privileges in schema public revoke all on sequences from anon, authenticated;
14	alter default privileges in schema public revoke all on functions from anon, authenticated;
15	alter default privileges in schema public revoke execute on functions from public;
16	alter default privileges in schema private revoke all on tables from anon, authenticated;
17	alter default privileges in schema private revoke all on sequences from anon, authenticated;
18	alter default privileges in schema private revoke all on functions from anon, authenticated;
19	alter default privileges in schema private revoke execute on functions from public;
20	-- R42: the per-schema form above cannot remove the global PUBLIC execute default (Postgres grants it
21	-- unless the role-wide default is revoked), so revoke it for the migration owner as well.
22	alter default privileges for role postgres revoke execute on functions from public;
23	
24	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	-- 1. Tables
26	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
27	create table public.organizations (
28	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
29	  name text not null check (char_length(btrim(name)) > 0),
30	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
31	);
32	
33	create table public.memberships (
34	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
35	  -- D17: unique(user_id) = a staff member or manager belongs to exactly one organization (R2).
36	  user_id uuid not null unique references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
37	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
38	  role text not null check (role in ('manager', 'staff')),
39	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
40	);
41	create index memberships_org_id_idx on public.memberships (org_id);
42	
43	create table public.units (
44	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
45	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
46	  name text not null check (char_length(btrim(name)) > 0),
47	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
48	  unique (org_id, name),
49	  unique (org_id, id) -- composite FK target: a lease can only point at a unit of its own org (R39)
50	);
51	
52	create table public.tenants (
53	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
54	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
55	  -- D17: tenant role comes from tenants.user_id, never user_metadata (R37).
56	  user_id uuid null references auth.users (id) on delete set null,
57	  full_name text not null check (char_length(btrim(full_name)) > 0),
58	  email text not null,
59	  phone text null check (phone ~ '^\+?[0-9][0-9 -]{5,19}$'),
60	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
61	  unique (org_id, user_id),
62	  unique (org_id, id)
63	);
64	create index tenants_user_id_idx on public.tenants (user_id); -- RLS: user_id = auth.uid()
65	
66	create table public.leases (
67	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
68	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
69	  unit_id uuid not null,
70	  tenant_id uuid not null,
71	  start_date date not null,
72	  end_date date not null,
73	  monthly_rent_sen bigint not null check (monthly_rent_sen > 0), -- D3: bigint sen
74	  deposit_sen bigint not null check (deposit_sen >= 0),
75	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'), -- D3: single currency
76	  created_by uuid null,
77	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
78	  check (end_date >= start_date),
79	  foreign key (org_id, unit_id) references public.units (org_id, id),
80	  foreign key (org_id, tenant_id) references public.tenants (org_id, id),
81	  unique (org_id, id),
82	  unique (id, org_id),
83	  -- D16: same-unit leases never overlap, both dates inclusive, race-proof (23P01 -> 409) (R46).
84	  constraint leases_no_overlap exclude using gist (
85	    unit_id with =,
86	    daterange(start_date, end_date, '[]') with &&
87	  )
88	);
89	create index leases_org_unit_idx on public.leases (org_id, unit_id);
90	create index leases_org_tenant_idx on public.leases (org_id, tenant_id);
91	create index leases_tenant_id_idx on public.leases (tenant_id);
92	
93	create table public.invoices (
94	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
95	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
96	  lease_id uuid not null,
97	  kind text not null check (kind in ('deposit', 'rent')),
98	  period_index int null,
99	  period_start date null,
100	  period_end date null,
101	  due_date date not null,
102	  -- R46: lease creation stores exactly generateSchedule's invoices, and a tiny last rent period can
103	  -- round to 0 sen; a deposit invoice exists only when the deposit is > 0.
104	  amount_sen bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0 or (kind = 'rent' and amount_sen = 0)),
105	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'),
106	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
107	  -- R12/R14: deposit has no period; a rent invoice has one, due on its anchor (period start).
108	  check (
109	    (kind = 'deposit' and period_index is null and period_start is null and period_end is null)
110	    or (kind = 'rent' and period_index is not null and period_start is not null and period_end is not null
111	        and period_index >= 0 and period_end >= period_start and due_date = period_start)
112	  ),
113	  foreign key (org_id, lease_id) references public.leases (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
114	  -- R12/R16: deposit rows have period_index null, so NULLS NOT DISTINCT = at most one deposit per lease
115	  -- and one rent invoice per period index (a partial unique on lease_id would make Prisma model lease 1:1).
116	  constraint invoices_lease_period_index_key unique nulls not distinct (lease_id, period_index),
117	  unique (org_id, lease_id, period_start), -- kit rule: invoice generation idempotent per period
118	  unique (org_id, id),
119	  unique (lease_id, id) -- target for payment_allocations: invoice and payment on the same lease
120	);
121	create index invoices_org_lease_idx on public.invoices (org_id, lease_id);
122	
123	create table public.gateway_bills (
124	  -- R30: gen_random_uuid() = 122 random bits, so bill ids cannot be guessed.
125	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
126	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
127	  lease_id uuid not null,
128	  amount_sen bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0),
129	  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending', 'paid', 'failed')),
130	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'),
131	  created_by uuid null,
132	  transaction_id text null,
133	  transaction_status text null,
134	  paid_at timestamptz null,
135	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
136	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
137	  check (status <> 'paid' or paid_at is not null),
138	  foreign key (org_id, lease_id) references public.leases (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
139	  unique (org_id, id),
140	  unique (lease_id, id)
141	);
142	create index gateway_bills_org_lease_idx on public.gateway_bills (org_id, lease_id);
143	create index gateway_bills_lease_id_idx on public.gateway_bills (lease_id);
144	
145	create table public.payments (
146	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
147	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
148	  lease_id uuid not null,
149	  amount_sen bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0),
150	  unapplied_sen bigint not null default 0,
151	  method text not null check (method in ('cash', 'bank_transfer', 'online')),
152	  status text not null check (status in ('pending_verification', 'approved', 'rejected', 'voided')),
153	  received_at timestamptz not null,
154	  slip_path text null unique, -- D22: one slip file backs at most one payment
155	  gateway_bill_id uuid null unique, -- D10: "A bill creates at most one payment, ever." (R35)
156	  idempotency_key uuid null, -- D9: optional Idempotency-Key header
157	  currency char(3) not null default 'MYR' check (currency = 'MYR'),
158	  recorded_by uuid null,
159	  decided_by uuid null,
160	  decided_at timestamptz null,
161	  reason text null,
162	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
163	  check (unapplied_sen >= 0 and unapplied_sen <= amount_sen),
164	  -- R26: only online money can be left unapplied (manual payments are capped, R22/R23).
165	  check (method = 'online' or unapplied_sen = 0),
166	  check ((method = 'bank_transfer') = (slip_path is not null)), -- R20
167	  check ((method = 'online') = (gateway_bill_id is not null)),
168	  -- D22/R44: a slip lives in its own organization's folder <org_id>/...
169	  check (slip_path is null or split_part(slip_path, '/', 1) = org_id::text),
170	  -- R24: reject and void need a reason of at least 5 characters; coalesce because a NULL reason
171	  -- would make the CHECK evaluate to NULL, which passes.
172	  check (status not in ('rejected', 'voided') or coalesce(char_length(btrim(reason)), 0) >= 5),
173	  foreign key (org_id, lease_id) references public.leases (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
174	  foreign key (org_id, gateway_bill_id) references public.gateway_bills (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
175	  foreign key (lease_id, gateway_bill_id) references public.gateway_bills (lease_id, id) on delete restrict,
176	  -- gateway_bill_id is already unique; these two composite uniques are the exact FK column sets so the
177	  -- relations introspect as 1:1 in Prisma, and they double as the FK indexes.
178	  unique (org_id, gateway_bill_id),
179	  unique (lease_id, gateway_bill_id),
180	  unique (org_id, idempotency_key),
181	  unique (org_id, id),

187	create table public.payment_allocations (
188	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
189	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
190	  lease_id uuid not null,
191	  payment_id uuid not null,
192	  invoice_id uuid not null,
193	  amount_sen bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0),
194	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
195	  -- lease_id in both FKs makes "payment and invoice belong to the same lease" a DB fact.
196	  foreign key (lease_id, payment_id) references public.payments (lease_id, id) on delete restrict,
197	  foreign key (lease_id, invoice_id) references public.invoices (lease_id, id) on delete restrict,
198	  foreign key (org_id, lease_id) references public.leases (org_id, id) on delete restrict,
199	  unique (payment_id, invoice_id)
200	);
201	create index payment_allocations_lease_payment_idx on public.payment_allocations (lease_id, payment_id);
202	create index payment_allocations_lease_invoice_idx on public.payment_allocations (lease_id, invoice_id);
203	create index payment_allocations_org_lease_idx on public.payment_allocations (org_id, lease_id);
204	create index payment_allocations_invoice_id_idx on public.payment_allocations (invoice_id);
205	
206	create table public.audit_log (
207	  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
208	  org_id uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
209	  actor_id uuid null,
210	  action text not null,
211	  entity_id uuid null,
212	  details jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
213	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
214	);
215	create index audit_log_org_created_idx on public.audit_log (org_id, created_at);
216	
217	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
218	-- 2. Guard triggers (schema private)
219	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
220	-- D19/R43: audit_log is append-only for every role, owner and service_role included.
221	create function private.audit_log_append_only() returns trigger
222	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
223	begin
224	  raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'audit_log is append-only';
225	end $$;
226	
227	create trigger audit_log_no_update_delete before update or delete on public.audit_log
228	  for each row execute function private.audit_log_append_only();
229	create trigger audit_log_no_truncate before truncate on public.audit_log
230	  for each statement execute function private.audit_log_append_only();
231	-- D19: ALWAYS = still fires under session_replication_role = replica.
232	alter table public.audit_log enable always trigger audit_log_no_update_delete;
233	alter table public.audit_log enable always trigger audit_log_no_truncate;
234	
235	-- D12: payments are never deleted; only the decision columns change, along fixed status transitions.
236	create function private.payments_guard() returns trigger
237	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
238	begin
239	  if tg_op <> 'UPDATE' then
240	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Payments are never deleted';
241	  end if;
242	  -- D12: compare the whole row minus the mutable keys, so any future column is immutable by default.
243	  if (to_jsonb(new) - array['status', 'decided_by', 'decided_at', 'reason', 'unapplied_sen'])
244	     is distinct from (to_jsonb(old) - array['status', 'decided_by', 'decided_at', 'reason', 'unapplied_sen']) then
245	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Payment facts are immutable';
246	  end if;
247	  if new.status is distinct from old.status and not (
248	       (old.status = 'pending_verification' and new.status in ('approved', 'rejected'))
249	       or (old.status = 'approved' and new.status = 'voided')) then
250	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Payment status cannot change that way';
251	  end if;
252	  return new;
253	end $$;
254	
255	create trigger payments_guard_row before update or delete on public.payments
256	  for each row execute function private.payments_guard();
257	create trigger payments_guard_truncate before truncate on public.payments
258	  for each statement execute function private.payments_guard();
259	alter table public.payments enable always trigger payments_guard_row;
260	alter table public.payments enable always trigger payments_guard_truncate;
261	
262	-- Allocations are deleted by void (R24) but never edited in place.
263	create function private.payment_allocations_no_update() returns trigger
264	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
265	begin
266	  raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Allocations cannot be updated';
267	end $$;
268	
269	create trigger payment_allocations_no_update before update on public.payment_allocations
270	  for each row execute function private.payment_allocations_no_update();
271	
272	-- Generic guard: the columns named in the trigger arguments never change after insert.
273	create function private.forbid_column_changes() returns trigger
274	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
275	declare
276	  v_col text;
277	begin
278	  foreach v_col in array tg_argv loop
279	    if (to_jsonb(new) -> v_col) is distinct from (to_jsonb(old) -> v_col) then
280	      raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = format('%s.%s is immutable', tg_table_name, v_col);
281	    end if;
282	  end loop;
283	  return new;
284	end $$;
285	
286	-- Lease terms and invoice amounts/dates are facts fixed at creation (R46: exactly generateSchedule's invoices).
287	create trigger leases_immutable before update on public.leases
288	  for each row execute function private.forbid_column_changes(
289	    'id', 'org_id', 'unit_id', 'tenant_id', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'monthly_rent_sen', 'deposit_sen', 'currency');
290	create trigger invoices_immutable before update on public.invoices
291	  for each row execute function private.forbid_column_changes(
292	    'id', 'org_id', 'lease_id', 'kind', 'period_index', 'period_start', 'period_end', 'due_date', 'amount_sen', 'currency');
293	
294	-- R34: a bill's amount and lease never change and its status only moves forward ("a paid bill never goes back").
295	create function private.gateway_bills_guard() returns trigger
296	language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
297	begin
298	  if tg_op <> 'UPDATE' then
299	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Gateway bills are never deleted';
300	  end if;
301	  if (new.id, new.org_id, new.lease_id, new.amount_sen, new.currency, new.created_by, new.created_at)
302	     is distinct from (old.id, old.org_id, old.lease_id, old.amount_sen, old.currency, old.created_by, old.created_at) then
303	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Gateway bill facts are immutable';
304	  end if;
305	  if new.status is distinct from old.status and not (
306	       (old.status = 'pending' and new.status in ('paid', 'failed'))
307	       or (old.status = 'failed' and new.status = 'paid')) then
308	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Gateway bill status cannot go back';
309	  end if;
310	  -- R34: a paid bill never goes back, so its payment facts are frozen too.
311	  if old.status = 'paid'
312	     and (new.paid_at, new.transaction_id, new.transaction_status)
313	         is distinct from (old.paid_at, old.transaction_id, old.transaction_status) then
314	    raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'A paid gateway bill cannot change';
315	  end if;
316	  return new;
317	end $$;
318	
319	create trigger gateway_bills_guard_row before update or delete on public.gateway_bills
320	  for each row execute function private.gateway_bills_guard();
321	create trigger gateway_bills_guard_truncate before truncate on public.gateway_bills
322	  for each statement execute function private.gateway_bills_guard();
323	-- D19: ALWAYS = still fires under session_replication_role = replica.
324	alter table public.gateway_bills enable always trigger gateway_bills_guard_row;
325	alter table public.gateway_bills enable always trigger gateway_bills_guard_truncate;
326	
327	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
328	-- 3. RLS helpers (SECURITY DEFINER so policies never recurse through RLS; search_path '' against hijacking)
329	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
330	create function private.is_org_member(p_org uuid, p_roles text[]) returns boolean
331	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
332	  select exists (
333	    select 1 from public.memberships m
334	    where m.org_id = p_org and m.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and m.role = any (p_roles)
335	  )
336	$$;
337	
338	create function private.is_lease_tenant(p_lease uuid) returns boolean
339	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
340	  select exists (
341	    select 1
342	    from public.leases l
343	    join public.tenants t on t.org_id = l.org_id and t.id = l.tenant_id
344	    where l.id = p_lease and t.user_id = (select auth.uid())
345	  )
346	$$;
347	
348	create function private.is_tenant_org(p_org uuid) returns boolean
349	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
350	  select exists (
351	    select 1 from public.tenants t where t.org_id = p_org and t.user_id = (select auth.uid())
352	  )
353	$$;
354	
355	-- D22/R44: first folder of the object path must be an org where the caller is manager or staff.
356	-- Compared as text so a garbage folder name returns false instead of raising a uuid cast error.
357	create function private.can_upload_slip(p_object_name text) returns boolean
358	language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
359	  select exists (
360	    select 1 from public.memberships m
361	    where m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
362	      and m.role in ('manager', 'staff')
363	      and m.org_id::text = (storage.foldername(p_object_name))[1]
364	  )
365	$$;
366	
367	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
368	-- 4. Row level security (R42 Data API matrix). SELECT only, plus tenant phone update.
369	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
370	alter table public.organizations enable row level security;
371	alter table public.memberships enable row level security;
372	alter table public.units enable row level security;
373	alter table public.tenants enable row level security;
374	alter table public.leases enable row level security;
375	alter table public.invoices enable row level security;
376	alter table public.gateway_bills enable row level security;
377	alter table public.payments enable row level security;
378	alter table public.payment_allocations enable row level security;
379	alter table public.audit_log enable row level security;
380	
381	create policy organizations_select on public.organizations for select to authenticated
382	  using (private.is_org_member(id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_tenant_org(id));
383	
384	create policy memberships_select on public.memberships for select to authenticated
385	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']));
386	
387	create policy units_select on public.units for select to authenticated
388	  using (
389	    private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff'])
390	    or exists (
391	      select 1 from public.leases l
392	      where l.org_id = units.org_id and l.unit_id = units.id and private.is_lease_tenant(l.id)
393	    )
394	  );
395	
396	create policy tenants_select on public.tenants for select to authenticated
397	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or user_id = (select auth.uid()));
398	
399	-- R42: tenant updates only their own phone (column grant below limits the columns; WITH CHECK keeps the row theirs).
400	create policy tenants_update_own_phone on public.tenants for update to authenticated
401	  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()))
402	  with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
403	
404	create policy leases_select on public.leases for select to authenticated
405	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(id));
406	
407	create policy invoices_select on public.invoices for select to authenticated
408	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
409	
410	create policy gateway_bills_select on public.gateway_bills for select to authenticated
411	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
412	
413	create policy payments_select on public.payments for select to authenticated
414	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
415	
416	create policy payment_allocations_select on public.payment_allocations for select to authenticated
417	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager', 'staff']) or private.is_lease_tenant(lease_id));
418	
419	create policy audit_log_select on public.audit_log for select to authenticated
420	  using (private.is_org_member(org_id, array['manager']));
421	
422	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
423	-- 5. Grants (after every object exists)
424	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
425	revoke all on all tables in schema public from anon, authenticated;
426	revoke all on all sequences in schema public from anon, authenticated;
427	revoke all on all functions in schema public from anon, authenticated;
428	revoke all on all functions in schema private from public, anon, authenticated;
429	
430	grant select on public.organizations, public.memberships, public.units, public.tenants, public.leases,
431	  public.invoices, public.gateway_bills, public.payments, public.payment_allocations, public.audit_log
432	  to authenticated;
433	grant update (phone) on public.tenants to authenticated;
434	
435	-- Policies (and Storage's RLS) call these helpers as the authenticated role; nothing else in private is callable.
436	grant usage on schema private to authenticated;
437	grant execute on function private.is_org_member(uuid, text[]) to authenticated;
438	grant execute on function private.is_lease_tenant(uuid) to authenticated;
439	grant execute on function private.is_tenant_org(uuid) to authenticated;
440	grant execute on function private.can_upload_slip(text) to authenticated;
441	
442	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
443	-- 6. Storage: private slip bucket + object policies (R20, R44, D22)
444	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
445	insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
446	values ('payment-slips', 'payment-slips', false, 5242880, '{image/jpeg,image/png,application/pdf}')
447	on conflict (id) do nothing;
448	
449	-- Staff/manager of the org in the first folder may upload and read; no update/delete/list for anyone else.
450	create policy payment_slips_insert on storage.objects for insert to authenticated
451	  with check (bucket_id = 'payment-slips' and private.can_upload_slip(name));
452	
453	create policy payment_slips_select on storage.objects for select to authenticated
454	  using (bucket_id = 'payment-slips' and private.can_upload_slip(name));

117	// GET /api/leases/:leaseId, the brief's shape exactly. asOf drives the overdue status (R17).
118	export async function getLease(ctx: ServiceCtx, leaseId: string, asOf: Date = new Date()): Promise<LeaseDetail> {
119	  const caller = await loadCaller(ctx.userId)

124	    prisma.invoices.findMany({ where: scope }),
125	    prisma.payment_allocations.groupBy({ by: ['invoice_id'], where: scope, _sum: { amount_sen: true } }),
126	    prisma.payments.findMany({ where: scope, orderBy: [{ received_at: 'asc' }, { created_at: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }] }),
127	  ])

130	  const invoices = invoiceRows.map((row) => serializeInvoice(row, paid.get(row.id) ?? 0, asOf)).sort(compareAllocationOrder)

136	// Leases list for the UI: staff/manager see their org's leases; a tenant sees only their own.

138	  const caller = await loadCaller(ctx.userId)
139	  const or: ({ org_id: string } | { tenant_id: { in: string[] } })[] = []
140	  if (caller.member) or.push({ org_id: caller.member.orgId })

135	  } catch (e) {

159	  if (parsed.error.issues.some((i) => i.path[0] === 'reason')) throw badRequest(REASON_MESSAGE)

35	// even when the body is malformed JSON. createLease repeats the check, so it is safe to call alone.

40	export async function createLease(ctx: ServiceCtx, input: unknown): Promise<{ id: string }> {
41	  const caller = await loadCaller(ctx.userId)
42	  // POST /api/leases has no target record yet, so the role check (403) precedes body validation (400).
43	  const { orgId } = requireMember(caller, ['manager'])
44	  const body = createLeaseSchema.parse(input)
45	
46	  // R11/R46: the schedule comes only from billing.ts; its validation errors are the 400 message.
47	  let schedule: ScheduledInvoice[]
48	  try {
49	    schedule = generateSchedule(body)
50	  } catch (e) {
51	    throw badRequest(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Invalid lease')
52	  }
53	
54	  // R39/D15: body ids are untrusted; a unit or tenant outside the caller's org is a 404, exactly like a
55	  // nonexistent one, so another org's ids are never confirmed. The composite FKs enforce the same in the DB.
56	  const [unit, tenant] = await Promise.all([
57	    prisma.units.findFirst({ where: { id: body.unitId, org_id: orgId }, select: { id: true } }),
58	    prisma.tenants.findFirst({ where: { id: body.tenantId, org_id: orgId }, select: { id: true } }),
59	  ])
60	  if (!unit) throw notFound('Unit not found')
61	  if (!tenant) throw notFound('Tenant not found')
62	
63	  // R46: lease + exactly the scheduled invoices + audit row commit together or not at all. Overlap is
64	  // enforced by the leases_no_overlap EXCLUDE constraint (D16): a concurrent overlapping insert waits,
65	  // then fails with 23P01, which errors.ts maps to 409. withRetry covers a deadlock (40P01) once.
66	  return withRetry(() =>
67	    prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
68	      const lease = await tx.leases.create({
69	        data: {

71	          unit_id: body.unitId,
72	          tenant_id: body.tenantId,
73	          start_date: isoDateToDb(body.startDate),
74	          end_date: isoDateToDb(body.endDate),
75	          monthly_rent_sen: body.monthlyRentSen,
76	          deposit_sen: body.depositSen,
77	          created_by: caller.userId,
78	        },
79	        select: { id: true },
80	      })

84	          lease_id: lease.id,

86	          period_index: inv.periodIndex,
87	          period_start: inv.periodStart === null ? null : isoDateToDb(inv.periodStart),
88	          period_end: inv.periodEnd === null ? null : isoDateToDb(inv.periodEnd),
89	          due_date: isoDateToDb(inv.dueDate),
90	          amount_sen: inv.amountSen,
91	        })),
92	      })

96	          actor_id: caller.userId,
97	          action: 'lease.created',
98	          entity_id: lease.id,
99	          details: {
100	            unitId: body.unitId,
101	            tenantId: body.tenantId,
102	            startDate: body.startDate,
103	            endDate: body.endDate,
104	            monthlyRentSen: body.monthlyRentSen,
105	            depositSen: body.depositSen,
106	            invoiceCount: schedule.length,
107	          },
108	        },
109	      })

111	    }),

117	// GET /api/leases/:leaseId, the brief's shape exactly. asOf drives the overdue status (R17).
118	export async function getLease(ctx: ServiceCtx, leaseId: string, asOf: Date = new Date()): Promise<LeaseDetail> {
119	  const caller = await loadCaller(ctx.userId)
120	  const lease = await requireLeaseAccess(caller, leaseId, ['manager', 'staff', 'tenant'])
121	  // Every query is scoped by the checked lease's own org_id as well as its id (D18).
122	  const scope = { lease_id: lease.id, org_id: lease.org_id }
123	  const [invoiceRows, allocationSums, paymentRows] = await Promise.all([
124	    prisma.invoices.findMany({ where: scope }),
125	    prisma.payment_allocations.groupBy({ by: ['invoice_id'], where: scope, _sum: { amount_sen: true } }),
126	    prisma.payments.findMany({ where: scope, orderBy: [{ received_at: 'asc' }, { created_at: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }] }),
127	  ])
128	  // Voiding deletes that payment's allocations (D14), so every remaining allocation counts as paid.
129	  const paid = paidByInvoice(allocationSums)
130	  const invoices = invoiceRows.map((row) => serializeInvoice(row, paid.get(row.id) ?? 0, asOf)).sort(compareAllocationOrder)
131	  return { lease: serializeLease(lease), invoices, payments: paymentRows.map(serializePayment) }
132	}

137	export async function listLeases(ctx: ServiceCtx): Promise<LeaseListItem[]> {
138	  const caller = await loadCaller(ctx.userId)
139	  const or: ({ org_id: string } | { tenant_id: { in: string[] } })[] = []
140	  if (caller.member) or.push({ org_id: caller.member.orgId })
141	  if (caller.tenantIds.length > 0) or.push({ tenant_id: { in: caller.tenantIds } })
142	  if (or.length === 0) throw forbidden()
143	  const rows = await prisma.leases.findMany({
144	    where: { OR: or },
145	    include: { units: { select: { name: true } }, tenants: { select: { full_name: true } } },
146	    orderBy: [{ start_date: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
147	  })
148	  return rows
149	    .map((row) => ({ ...serializeLease(row), unitName: row.units.name, tenantName: row.tenants.full_name }))
150	    .sort((a, b) => (a.unitName === b.unitName ? 0 : a.unitName < b.unitName ? -1 : 1))
151	}
